items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I think I was standing at St. Claude between Oisline and Governor Nicholas.

ctx.x: Wilbert Tillman, he's pretty good. And the guy I play with, the Gibson band that I heard, I mean playing a few of them, I think I was standing at St. Claude between Oisline and Governor Nicholas. And Willie Humphrey told me that tuba player he was a barber. And I can't recall his name. He's a barber, he's a good tuba player. It's not Louis Caput though.
